translated_title: Foreign Affairs Secretariat Responds to Texas: The Border on the Río Bravo Cannot Be Modified by a State Government
original_title: Cancillería responde a Texas: la frontera en el río Bravo no puede modificarla un gobierno estatal
author: Emir Olivares
meta_description: Texas claims 66 acres between Laredo and McAllen so U.S. forces can patrol them, though it admits no criminal activity has been confirmed there.
